metadata.author: V2 expansion (subagent draft)
metadata.key_test: Long-run P1 ordinal from near-identical decolonization/colonial starts: do divergent institutional choices (Ghana's democratic consolidation vs. Cote d'Ivoire's 2002-2011 civil wars) track P1? Pre-1996 P1 is a near-tie (0.477 vs 0.479) -- a hard case where divergence is driven by post-1996 institutional choices the starting P1 does not yet distinguish.
metadata.notes: Reference-based record: indicators resolved live via mi.datasource (country_ref + year). resolved_scores carry the MI v2 re-scored pillars. Cote d'Ivoire ref uses ASCII spelling to match the panel key.

pre_event.event_description: Two near-identical West African decolonization starts (Ghana ind. 1957, Cote d'Ivoire ind. 1960) measured at a common 1996 baseline before their institutional trajectories sharply diverge.

context.neighbor_details: Sahel/regional instability spillover; no direct interstate threat.

Ghana.notes: Indicators resolved via mi.datasource (Ghana, 1996 -> 2024). Decolonization start closely matched to Cote d'Ivoire; divergence hypothesis tests institutional choice over starting conditions.

Cote d'Ivoire.notes: Indicators resolved via mi.datasource (Cote d'Ivoire, 1996 -> 2024). 'Ivoirite' ethnicized citizenship politics emerging post-Houphouet (d. 1993); 1999 coup, 2002-2007 north-south war, 2010-2011 post-election crisis.

a_trajectory_ranking.basis: Pre-P1 essentially identical (Ghana 0.477 vs Cote d'Ivoire 0.479, gap 0.002 << 0.10 margin). Mechanical ordinal is a tie; the divergence hypothesis expects Ghana to pull ahead via institutional consolidation.
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Cote d'Ivoire ends at or above Ghana on post-MI.

b_violence.prediction: Both mid-band P1 -> moderate violence risk; the framework's 1996 reading does NOT single out Cote d'Ivoire over Ghana.
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY.
b_violence.falsification_condition: Neither country experiences elevated political violence.

c_convergence.prediction: Divergence (institutional choices diverge despite near-identical 1996 P1)
c_convergence.basis: Case hypothesis: divergent institutional settlements; caveat -- the 0.002 pre-P1 gap is below margin, so the raw P1 signal is weak and would mechanically read convergence.

d_failure_dimension.prediction: Cote d'Ivoire primary failure on P1 (ethnicized political settlement / institutional legitimacy) with P5 cohesion collapse.
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias.
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: Cote d'Ivoire's failure driven by a non-institutional dimension.

e_fragment_count.prediction: No permanent fragmentation; Cote d'Ivoire de facto north-south partition is transient and reunifies (n_successor_states stays 1 each).
e_fragment_count.falsification_condition: Either state permanently fragments into successor states.

f_reversal_risk.prediction: Ghana low democratic-reversal risk (consolidating alternation); Cote d'Ivoire elevated reversal risk.
f_reversal_risk.falsification_condition: Ghana suffers democratic reversal / Cote d'Ivoire shows none.

g_suppression_mechanism.classification: N/A -- neither is a suppressed-fragmentation suppression-tier case.

h_substate_turbulence.prediction: Cote d'Ivoire sub-state turbulence triggered (regional/ethnic rebel control of the north, Forces Nouvelles); Ghana none.
h_substate_turbulence.falsification_condition: No sub-state armed turbulence in Cote d'Ivoire.

Ghana.outcome_summary: P1 0.477->0.515; MI 0.474->0.502 (Tier 3). Sustained multiparty democracy with repeated peaceful alternations of power (2000, 2008, 2016, 2024); a regional democratic exemplar despite economic strain.

Cote d'Ivoire.outcome_summary: P1 0.479->0.474 (flat); MI 0.511->0.445 (Tier 3, declined). 1999 coup, 2002-2007 north-south civil war, 2010-2011 post-election crisis (~3,000 dead); reunified and stabilized after 2011 but P5 cohesion collapsed (0.652->0.394).

a_trajectory.evidence: Outcome Ghana > Cote d'Ivoire by post-MI (0.502 vs 0.445); but pre-P1 gap was 0.002, below margin.
a_trajectory.explanation: AUTO (Mod4): full pre-P1 gap 0.002 < margin 0.1 -> abstain (too close to call). | prior: AUTO (Mod4): full pre-P1 gap 0.002 < margin 0.1 -> abstain (too close to call). | prior: AUTO (Mod4): full pre-P1 gap 0.002 < margin 0.1 -> abstain (too close to call). | prior: Direction matches the hypothesis (Ghana ahead) but the ordering was a Mod4 near-tie at the 1996 baseline -- the divergence was earned by post-1996 institutional choices the starting P1 could not distinguish. Coded PARTIAL.

b_violence.evidence: Cote d'Ivoire: 2002-2007 civil war + 2010-2011 crisis (~3,000 dead). Ghana: peaceful.
b_violence.explanation: Elevated risk materialized -- but in Cote d'Ivoire specifically, which the near-identical 1996 P1 did not single out from Ghana. Risk realized; discrimination weak. PARTIAL.

c_convergence.evidence: Post-MI gap widened (Ghana up, Cote d'Ivoire down; ~0.057 gap); pre-P1 gap was ~0.002.
c_convergence.explanation: Outcome diverged as the case hypothesis expected, but the raw pre-P1 gap was below the divergence margin and would mechanically have read convergence. PARTIAL.

d_failure_dimension.evidence: Cote d'Ivoire P5 cohesion collapsed 0.652->0.394; P1 flat-to-declining amid ethnicized settlement.
d_failure_dimension.explanation: Institutional/cohesion failure as predicted; post-hoc dimension identification coded PARTIAL under strict standards.

analysis.overall_assessment: Matched-start decolonization control. P1 ordinal alone was a near-tie at 1996; divergence was real and large but earned by post-baseline institutional choices, so a/b/c code PARTIAL while the safeguard-style calls (e/f/h) are clean.
new_failure_modes_discovered: Near-identical starting P1 can precede large divergence -- the framework reads convergence where institutional choice later drives divergence (decolonization blind spot).
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Shared colonial start control: institutions, not the 1996 P1 level, drive the Ghana/Cote d'Ivoire divergence.
proposed_framework_modifications: Flag near-tie pre-P1 pairs as low-confidence ordinal predictions rather than convergence calls.
analysis.baseline_impact: Flag is additive; no baseline change.
analysis.phase3_note: Migrated to MI v1 + Data API references. a_trajectory/c_convergence auto-derived from real re-scored data (Mod4-gated); b/d/e/f/g/h preserved as judgment.
analysis.judgment_refresh_note: Judgment verdicts (b/d/e/f/g/h) re-examined against MI v1 real-data scores on 2026-06-28: no verdict flips (directional readings robust to the legacy->anchored vintage change); b risk-levels refreshed from real pre-P1, d augmented with the real config (weakest pillar flagged as a binding vulnerability only when below median), safeguards re-evaluated.

lead_time.method: outcome anchored at 2024; predictor = pre-event P1 at (2024-lead); Mod4 margin + V3 consolidated-pair caution (abstain = correctly cautious, not a miss).
lead_time.note: ordinal call correct/cautious at all tested leads (no horizon decay)
